name: Pantalla OLED
description: Pantallas OLED I2C SSD1306 y SH1106 (128×64 o 128×32): texto por filas, barras y borrar, sin librerías y casi sin RAM. Arduino y MicroPython.

en.Pantallas OLED I2C SSD1306 y SH1106 (128: SSD1306 and SH1106 I2C OLED displays (128×64 or 128×32): text by rows, bars and clear, without libraries and almost no RAM. Arduino and MicroPython.
